Call 6:45 AM at M3. Clear, 50F, wind 10-15 mph.

Midnight Shift – Daily Production Log
Project: Midnight Shift / “MS”
Owner: Lila Kim
Log period: 3/20/23 – 3/31/23

General note: All times are call/wrap for the unit unless noted. Location codes: M1 = warehouse exterior, M2 = warehouse interior, M3 = rooftop, M4 = diner interior, M5 = car interior (process trailer). Weather noted each morning and at wrap.

3/20/23 (Mon)
Call 7:00 AM at M1. Cloudy, 48F, light drizzle until 10:30.
First day of principal photography. The daily log notes that Project 'Midnight Shift' actual_start_date was 2023-03-20. Record status: current.
Shot scenes 1, 2, 3A (ext. warehouse, Marcus arrival, first look at the building). Camera A: handheld, Camera B: jib for the wide. Wrapped 6:42 PM. No delays other than the drizzle. Lunch 30 min late due to grip truck arriving 20 min late (driver had wrong address, said GPS took him to the old mill site). 2nd AD noted that the mill site is 3 mi away and we should update the call sheet map for the rest of the week.

3/21/23 (Tue)
Call 7:30 AM at M2. Foggy, 52F. Fog burned off by 11.
Scenes 3B, 4, 5, 6A (int. warehouse, Marcus meets Elena, the first confrontation, discovery of the lockbox). Elena’s costume had a torn sleeve during scene 4 – wardrobe fixed on set in 15 min. No other issues. Wrapped 7:10 PM. Shot list for tomorrow: scenes 6B, 7, 8A. Need the practical fluorescents for M2 – gaffer says we have enough 4’ tubes but we’re short on 8’ ones. He’ll rent from City Light by Thursday.

3/22/23 (Wed)
Call 7:00 AM at M2. Rain all morning, 55F. No exterior work possible.
Scenes 6B, 7, 8A (int. warehouse, Elena finds the key, Marcus’s backstory, the alarm triggers). Scene 7 required a slow push-in on Marcus’s face – took 4 takes because the dolly grip kept hitting a cable. We moved the cable, fine after that. Wrapped 6:55 PM. 1st AD reminded everyone about the safety meeting Friday for the rooftop sequence.

3/23/23 (Thu)
Call 7:15 AM at M2. Overcast, 58F.
Scenes 8B, 9, 10A (int. warehouse, the escape through the loading bay, Marcus’s phone call, Elena hides in the office). The loading bay door was sticking – maintenance came at 10:30 and fixed it in 20 min. No lost time. Wrapped 6:30 PM. Tomorrow: M3 rooftop, scenes 11, 12, 13A. Weather looks clear. Reminder to all: harnesses and safety line check at 6:45 AM.

3/24/23 (Fri)
Call 6:45 AM at M3. Clear, 50F, wind 10-15 mph.
Safety meeting done at 7:05. Scenes 11, 12, 13A (rooftop, Marcus and Elena argue, the helicopter passes, Marcus spots the van below). Wind was gusty during scene 12 – we used the wind as texture, no complaints. One take had a boom shadow on Elena’s face; we re-shot. Wrapped 7:20 PM. Full day, no delays.

3/25/23 (Sat)
No call. Rain all day. Lila checked the weather at 7 AM – decided to hold. No scenes shot. Office day for dept heads: Lila reviewed the budget with the line producer; I updated the shot list for next week. Note: we lost a day to weather – will need to fold scenes 13B and 14 into Monday’s schedule if possible.

3/26/23 (Sun)
No call. Day off. No log entries.

3/27/23 (Mon)
Call 7:00 AM at M2. Partly cloudy, 54F.
Scenes 13B, 14, 15A (int. warehouse, Marcus’s flashback, Elena finds the second lockbox, the phone rings). Scene 14 required a lot of coverage – 3 angles, 2 takes each. Wrapped 7:40 PM. We were 20 min behind at lunch because the crafty table ran out of coffee and the 2nd AD had to run to the gas station. Not a real delay.

3/28/23 (Tue)
Call 7:15 AM at M4. Sunny, 61F.
Scenes 15B, 16, 17 (diner interior, Elena waits, Marcus’s contact arrives, the exchange goes wrong). The diner owner was on set all day – very helpful, let us move the napkin dispensers. No issues. Wrapped 6:50 PM. Tomorrow: M5 car interior (process trailer), scenes 18, 19. Process trailer arrives at 8 AM.

3/29/23 (Wed)
Call 7:30 AM at M5. Clear, 63F.
Scenes 18, 19 (car interior, Marcus drives, Elena in the back seat, the argument). The process trailer was late by 30 min – the tow truck had a flat tire. We shot close-ups in the parked car while we waited. Wrapped 7:15 PM. No lost time overall.

The crew did a quick toast – no alcohol, just sparkling cider. We packed the truck that night. Tomorrow: no call. Equipment return scheduled for 4/25.

No call. Equipment return day. I drove the truck to the rental house at 8 AM. Returned the A-camera, B-camera, lenses, tripods, jib, and the sound kit. The rental house checked everything – no damage, just the usual wear. The only thing they flagged was a missing lens cap on the 50mm – I found it in the truck’s glove box. Handed it over. They signed off at 9:40 AM. I also returned the walkie-talkies to the production office – counted 12, all present. That’s a wrap on Midnight Shift. Final day was 4/25/23 – record status is current.
